Episode 228. Battle of Grosher Castle (5)
As soon as the three people confirmed Ragal's records, they returned to the Golden Ship.
The battle had already won a significant victory and entered a state of calm six hours ago, but the Union members inside the ship were still on alert, maintaining their equipment.
"Did you verify the relationship between Ragal and Kelliark? Ah, you've worked hard! Our Valeria!"
"Dr. You've also been through a lot. How's the Red Owl?"

"Fortunately, thanks to the protective shield, there was no significant problem with the power source and major circuits. I've fixed it all! In addition, while checking for any modifications needed, I saw things that could be applied to the mass-produced Red Owl. Ironically, the leader's rough handling of the Red Owl ended up being helpful."
"Oh, anyway, our little guy somehow manages to land on his feet no matter what."
Jin picked up the ship's communication device.
"Manager, are the Viseps present?"
{Only Sir Tilius is here. I'll connect you right away.}
With the sudden onslaught of Inse's total attack, Sakiel had summoned most of the active Demon Kings to Grosher Castle.
However, Tilius and Misol were exceptions. Zito's order for 'the two of them to rest for the time being' was still valid.
Even Viseps, who were granted freedom, as well as Sakiel, could not fathom Zito's intentions regarding this.
{Jin, how did it go?}
"The record about Ragal has come up. As we predicted, Kelliark was in Hell, and considering the part where he issued orders to Ragal, it's highly likely that he's treating Ragal like a subordinate."

{So, it's confirmed that Kelliark Zipple is receiving help from the witch. But as far as I know, even the witch can't completely break Zito's brainwashing... Could it be that Shino, the so-called god of fire, has abilities that surpass those of the witch?}
"I can't know for sure, but I don't think so. It is true that Shino is classified as the highest-ranking god in Inse."

{A highest-ranking immortal... Well, I did hear from you about the Seal of Fire, something that everyone has to absolutely trust. The Seal of Fire, or some similar method, must have had some influence on the brainwashing.}
"I think so too, Tilius. Besides, not only the witch but also Ganesto is collaborating with Kelliark, so he might have gained some other ability that we don't know about."
{Hmm, Jin. Ragal is the most loyal to Zito. If Kelliark turned such a Ragal into his subordinate, that would mean... he could do the same with all other Demon Kings.}
"If Kelliark draws out the Demon Kings dependent on Zito and turns them into his subordinates... Wouldn't Zito just stand by and watch?"

"{I have no way of knowing what that madman is thinking. Kelliark might be unaware of him taking away people like Ragal, or he might know but let it be. Especially recently, it's been more and more difficult to understand. It's strange that he released Misol and me, and that he keeps on vacation even as Grosh Castle is under attack.}"
The same was true for Jin. It was hard to understand Zito's intentions.
Why can't he wage the invasion war on Insa more effectively with such a large force?
After learning about the approximate size and power of the Demon Realm Army thanks to Bisebs, Jin had been questioning Zito's troop deployment.

Rather, he should reduce the frequency of creating dimensional rifts and send out the top Demon Kings all at once, or if that's not feasible, quietly gather all superhuman warriors and forces at Grosh Castle before the total attack.
If it were Jin, he would have prepared for the invasion of Insa in that way.
'So far, the Demon Realm has been spreading its forces too indiscriminately...'
Jin did not initially evaluate the situation that way.
The sporadically appearing dimensional rifts always kept the Alliance on high alert, and without the returnees from the Black Sea, it would have been quite a struggle.
However, the Alliance managed to block all these rifts without major damage. They lost a few cities, but they were able to evacuate all the residents to safe areas.
Even before the total attack, they initiated a preemptive strike centered around Luna, and they scored a great victory at the start of the Grosh Castle offensive.
Yet Zito has yet to react significantly, and Sakiel is hastily defending Grosh Castle, so it's hard to understand what the enemies want.

'It doesn't seem like they're trying to win the war, but rather they're deliberately exhausting their forces. Or they might think that as long as Zito can travel comfortably, whether it's the Demon Kings or regular forces, it doesn't matter.'
Considering the 'full power of Zito' emphasized by transcendents like Ayulana Tess and Ameris, it was a plausible story. Of course, it still didn't make sense.
"It's indeed strange in many ways. But we'll have to keep advancing until his intentions become clear. We can't hesitate just because we don't know what he's scheming."
{You're right. We Bisebs have also determined that this could be our first and last chance.}
A hint of intrigue flashed in Jin's eyes.
"First and last chance, do you mean that Bisebs are going to actively move their forces?"

{Yes. Thanks to Insa's offense, most of the Demon Kings are hastily being deployed to Grosh Castle. In other words, the defense of the Demon Realm's base is getting weaker. While living as a fugitive for a long time, such a thing has never happened before.}
"That's what I've been waiting for, Tillyas. Are you confident that you can strike the base properly?"
{If Zito continues to be tied up and Phaelito comes down to the ground, it's definitely possible.}
Of course, even with the forces continually being replenished at Grosh Castle and even with Phaelito's departure, the demonic realm is still overwhelmingly powerful compared to Viseps.

Nevertheless, Viseps had a sense of trust. Among Viseps' spies, there were those who held positions that could influence the entire demonic realm. Viseps planned to cause massive chaos in the demonic realm's headquarters through them.
And they didn't hide this fact from Jin.
{We have an administrator of the artificial sun among our spies. And we... assume that the artificial sun serves as a sort of maintenance device that responds to Zito's consciousness.}
-Now it's your turn to explain the benefits. What benefits do we gain if we form an alliance with you?
-{We get a means to kill Zito.}
He remembered the conversation he had when he first communicated with Tilius.
"The way to kill Zito, it seems to be related to the artificial sun."
{Yes. But that's not all. Can I share the rest once you've broken through Grosh Castle and entered the demonic realm's headquarters?}
"It sounds like you still can't fully trust us."
{......That's not it. We just think we need a safety measure until the very end.}
"It's a joke, Tilius. I'm not ignorant of Viseps' position, do as you see fit. After all, without finishing off Zito, neither of us can move on."

{Thanks for understanding. Once our main force starts moving, we'll be able to dig deeper into Keliak Zipple, and check if he's really capturing other demon lords. And, there's one more important piece of news.}
"What is it?"
{There's intelligence that Phaelito will soon attack the Holy Kingdom of Banquela.}
It was expected.

Zito would definitely want to find his eyes being kept in the kingdom and strengthen his powers. If Zito himself isn't attacking the kingdom, it's natural for the best swordsman in the demonic realm to step forward.
"Any exact date?"

[I haven't been able to figure that out yet. However, if Insae continues to press Grosh Castle in the current atmosphere, there's a high possibility that Phaelito will sortie before the castle is fully conquered. Sakiel will want to buy as much time as possible.]
"No, I think differently. Sakiel would want to buy time, but would Zito? If that were the case, he wouldn't have wasted his army like this already."
[Then what?]
"If I were Zito, I would send Phaelito to the kingdom after Insae's main forces finish attacking Grosh Castle and enter the headquarters of the demonic realm."
In that case, the number of superhumans who can stop Phaelito would dramatically decrease among the humans.
There was a moment of silence. Tillyas and Visepts had not thought of that strategy at all.
{...That makes sense!}

"Of course, even if we start entering the Jinma Realm, we will leave enough defensive troops among the humans. But we don't know what variables are waiting for us in the Jinma Realm. Since we have already stepped there, we can't spare our troops."

{So if a variable occurs, humans are more likely to have to invest more to solve it, and if the humans run out, Phaelito will take the eye of the kingdom... If Zito regains strength as a result, the battle in the Jinma Realm could suddenly tilt.}
It was the worst-case scenario. Visepts anticipated that when Zito regains his eye, there would be no hope left in the world.

"Therefore, we must eliminate Phaelito before entering the Jinma Realm. So, you should somehow use your spies to find out when Phaelito will march into the human realm. Let him come up to the human realm before we push our main force into hell."
{I understand. I'll make it happen, no matter what.}
Tillyas responded in a calm voice, but he was certain that many sacrifices would follow if they were to drive Phaelito out, as Jin suggested.
To catch such a big fish, a matching bait is needed.
'Basset brother, or perhaps Silky, would have to play the role of bait. No, Silky can't... Is it just Basset brother.'
Jin read his heavy resolution hidden in his voice.
"If you need our help in this matter, feel free to tell us. We will support as much as possible."
{I will do that, Jin. Then let's communicate again next time. I need to go and report these matters to the headquarters.}
"Take care, Tillyas."
{You too. I always pray for your safety.}
Then, Jin called the Garden of Swords and Tikan.
"Housekeeper, Lord Kashimir. How is the rift situation? After the first line of defense fell, were there any new rifts added to our territory?"
{No, sir.}

{The same goes for the Huphester Union, Archduke. Rather, the frequency of rifts is decreasing than usual. We need to watch more, unless the enemies are smoking. It seems that even the rifts and troops that will be deployed to our main base are all being mobilized to Groshi Castle.}
Jin nodded.
"Understood, then we should press on them. If you notice even a slight increase in the rifts at the main base, please contact me immediately."
Jin put down the communicator and looked beyond the bridge. Ragaal's poison looked much thinner than before.
It was time to start the second attack.
